changelog: Google Sign-in now works for all users with a stable extension ID
Fixed OAuth flow — no more 'invalid request' or 'custom URI scheme' errors
Extension ID locked permanently via manifest key (same ID for every install)
Removed conflicting pre-warm auth call that caused 'only one web auth flow' error
Service worker keep-alive alarm now re-registers on every restart
Sign-in required for checks, with automatic resume after signing in
Redesigned popup and in-page card with a calmer, neutral look
Past chats reopen with their messages and fact-check cards
